submission.justification: Algorithm-L1 with a 32 GeV threshold is recommended as it achieves the highest signal efficiency (86.438%) among all viable candidates while satisfying all hard constraints. This represents a 12.148 percentage point improvement over the next-best option (Algorithm-L3 at 74.29%). Algorithm-L2 was eliminated due to exceeding the 4.0 μs latency constraint, which is a hard requirement imposed by front-end buffer limitations. The 32 GeV threshold was determined through systematic optimization, including fine-grained scanning around the efficiency peak. This configuration maximizes signal efficiency at the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate, directly fulfilling the project goal.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L1 achieves 86.438% efficiency at 32 GeV threshold, which is the maximum among all viable algorithms (12.148 percentage points higher than Algorithm-L3's 74.29%)
